primary_evidence.version: Publisher PDF / version of record per University of Dundee cover, 16 PDF pages including cover; internal article pagination 1-15.
primary_evidence.locators: PDF page 4: Figure 1, Table 2 and transformation Results; PDF page 6: Figures 3-4; PDF page 7: Figure 5; PDF pages 12-14: Experimental procedures; Discussion PDF pages 9-12.
primary_evidence.visual_checks: Rendered and inspected Figures 1 and 3-5 and Table 2, IMA pages 58/84. Figure 5 displays product patterns A/B versus feed C/D and glushinskite/struvite/dittmarite reference sticks. Figure 4 gives Mg/C/O product peaks and phosphate-containing feed spectra. Not independent raw diffraction refitting or quantitative phase analysis.
primary_evidence.conditions: ATCC 1015 living growth; 1% w/v synthetic dittmarite or natural struvite in malt extract agar, 5-mm mycelial plugs over cellophane, seven days at 25 C in dark. Figure 1C clearing image is three days, not seven. Crystal extraction in 80 C water, >=3 washes, vacuum desiccation; 105 C feed oven-sterilization and 105 rpm shaking belong to liquid-arm methods and are not imported into solid-arm records.
primary_evidence.controls: Feed XRD patterns and mineral-free fungal growth; no matched abiotic acid/oxalate experiment isolating oxalate contribution.
primary_evidence.outcome: Qualitative clearing, acidification and authors' XRD identification of glushinskite after growth. Dittmarite record preserves Table 2 pH for 1% synthetic treatment: 7.06 +/- 0.01 to 4.09 +/- 0.45, means +/- SD of three independent replicates. No invented mass balance, isolated yield, purity or industrial performance.
primary_evidence.counterevidence_and_inconsistencies: Amorphous debris accompanies crystals. Source calls XRD-identified dittmarite synthetic struvite. No exclusive oxalate mechanism is inferred. Discussion magnesium/oxalate reaction expression is not adopted. Liquid-medium methods give 105 rpm while Figure 9 caption says 125 rpm; liquid numerical endpoints and morphology claims are outside accepted records. Reported equimolar synthesis wording is not independently established from reagent amounts and is not repeated as a curated stoichiometric ratio.
primary_evidence.supplement_scope: No supporting-information section or separate supplement identified in inspected full PDF/publisher parser and first-result searches; no exhaustive absence claim or raw diffraction dataset inspection.
